# Time integration {#sec-ch07}

pin: snapy@c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f (chengcli/snapy); pyharp@4721715855e937c1e8b218e964c0655f46e56e29

This chapter advances the state in time. It takes as given the stage tendency of @sec-ch04 and the
sources of @sec-ch09 and describes what is done with them: the explicit strong-stability-preserving Runge-Kutta
stages, where the ghost exchange sits in a stage, the time-step bound, the acceptance or rejection of a step,
and the operator-split pieces at the end of a step; then the vertically implicit correction (VIC[^rg-719dabbf5e61]), which
replaces the explicit acoustic bound in $x_1$[^rg-2e085e796dc5] by an implicit solve along each column.

Part 7A is the explicit machinery that every run uses. Part 7B is the VIC, which a run uses only with
`integration/implicit-scheme` set. The gravity terms inside the VIC operator belong to @sec-ch06 and are not
repeated here. The positivity limiters whose marks can reject a step are @sec-ch08; this chapter only reads
their marks.

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Explicit SSP[^rg-dddd5731b7f9] Runge-Kutta stages (@sec-ch07-rk) | `integration/type` | `rk3` | 1, 2, 3, 3 | `test_forcing` |
| Ghost exchange in a stage (@sec-ch07-exchange) | driver API[^rg-bbcb5d2272d2] | MeshBlock: before | — | `test_mesh_multi_block` |
| Time-step bound (@sec-ch07-cfl) | `integration/cfl`, `implicit-advection-cfl`[^rg-17cfb00e016e], `shear-cfl`[^rg-99aed0617573] | 0.9, 1, 0 | — | `test_implicit_advection_cfl_python` |
| Step acceptance and redo (@sec-ch07-redo) | `max_redo` | 5 | — | `test_check_redo_floor_python` |
| Operator split at the step boundary (@sec-ch07-split) | `thermo.reactions` | none | 1 (Lie) | `test_wall_saturation` |
| VIC options and activation (@sec-ch07-vic-options) | `integration/implicit-scheme` | 0 (off) | — | `test_implicit_options_type_python` |
| VIC block-tridiagonal assembly (@sec-ch07-vic-assembly) | as above | off | linearised | `test_backward_substitution`, `test_vic_partial_tangential` |
| Stage-weighted implicit step (@sec-ch07-vic-stage) | rk3, rk3s4 | on with VIC | 1 | `test_forcing`, `test_implicit_face_work_operator_python` |
| Block Thomas sweep and back substitution (@sec-ch07-vic-sweep) | as above | off | direct | `test_lu_failure` |
| LU[^rg-3af720c3dfee] pivot tolerance (@sec-ch07-vic-pivot) | none | $\epsilon_{\mathrm{piv}}=8N\epsilon_{\mathrm m}$ | — | `test_lu_failure` |
| VIC rejection and rollback (@sec-ch07-vic-reject) | none | on with VIC | — | `test_lu_failure` |
| VIC constituent redistribution (@sec-ch07-vic-redistribute) | none | on with VIC | conservative | `test_backward_substitution` |
| VIC column closure (@sec-ch07-vic-closure) | none | reflecting | — | none dedicated |

<!-- reader glossary notes -->
[^rg-719dabbf5e61]: VIC — vertically implicit correction

[^rg-2e085e796dc5]: $x_1, x_2, x_3$ — the three coordinate directions; $x_1$ is always the vertical (radial) direction

[^rg-dddd5731b7f9]: SSP — strong stability preserving

[^rg-bbcb5d2272d2]: API — application programming interface

[^rg-17cfb00e016e]: implicit-advection-cfl — Courant limit for the implicitly treated advection

[^rg-99aed0617573]: shear-cfl — Courant limit associated with shear

[^rg-3af720c3dfee]: LU — lower–upper matrix factorisation

[^rg-9dfff25f07b9]: CPU — central processing unit

[^rg-2238129cb896]: CUDA — NVIDIA's parallel computing platform
<!-- end reader glossary notes -->
